sentences.text: Mr.Kanungo, learned counsel for the Petitioner, submits that he has obtained instructions from his client that he is ready and willing to marry the victim, who has attained the age of majority, and would make necessary arrangements for the same if he is released on interim bail for some time.

6. Considering the submission as above, the Court below is directed to release the Petitioner on interim bail for a period of four weeks from the date of his actual release on such terms and conditions as may be fixed by the court below including the condition that he shall not misuse the liberty granted to him and he shall personally appear before the trial court on each date of posting of the case without seeking any representation, failing which it shall be open to the said court to pass necessary orders to take him to custody again by issuing N.B.W.
7.
After expiry of the aforesaid period of four weeks, the Petitioner shall surrender before the court below, failing which appropriate warrant may be issued for his production.

8. List this matter in the week commencing 01.7.2024.
